Class DirectionalVariance

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tfx.DirectionalVariance
public final class DirectionalVariance extends Object
Generates random variances for directional effects.

DirectionalVariance is used by sweep and slide effects to add randomness to the animation, creating irregular patterns. It generates random offsets based on the effect's direction.

    • next

      public Position next()
      Generates the next variance value.

      Returns a Position offset representing the (x, y) variance to be applied. The generated variance is always within the range [-max, max] for the relevant axis, and 0 for the other axis.

      Returns:
      A Position representing the (x, y) variance offset
